title: A high-fidelity modern UI component specification diagram on clean white background: A sophisticated financial analytics line chart card from an ERP system (MyBilling Pro ERP). At the top header of the card, there are two distinct modern dropdown selector menus: Dropdown 1 titled 'Time Horizon / Comparison' set to 'This Week (vs Last Week)' with a visible opened menu or clean selector showing options 'Today (Hourly vs Yesterday)', 'This Week (vs Last Week)', 'This Month (vs Last Month)', and 'Q3 FY24-25 (vs Q2)'. Dropdown 2 titled 'Metric View' set to 'Revenue & Profit Trends' with options 'Revenue & Profit', 'Gross Revenue Only', 'Net Profit Only', 'Margin % Trend'. In the main chart area, there is an ultra-clean, elegant multi-line comparison graph: a smooth indigo/royal blue line (#4338ca) tracking Gross Revenue, a vibrant emerald green line (#10b981) tracking Net Profit, and a subtle dashed slate-gray line representing the Prior Period benchmark. Interactive tooltip hovered at Wednesday peak showing Revenue: ₹8,42,100, Net Profit: ₹1,82,450 (21.6% margin), vs Prior: +15.0%. Crisp typography, sharp data points with circular glowing nodes, subtle gradient area fills under lines, financial grid lines, KPI summary chips at the bottom. Clean, corporate, Executive Precision design language.
